entry.title: New: Bill 181 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Postponed
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 16, ARTICLE 1, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE (Draft 2) 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO THE GENERAL PLAN

Inserts amendment procedures for the General Plan, including a comprehensive review at least every ten years, and interim amendments between comprehensive reviews; describes the powers and duties of the Planning Director and Planning Commissions to review and recommend amendments, and of the Council to initiate or adopt proposed amendments.

Latest action: PCPLUD Postponed to the Call of the Chair - 11/08/24; never taken up again
